## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
Sector Rotation, not Risk-Off. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. XLK in CORRECTION (1W: -4.26% | 1M: +0.40%) while XLF ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.46% | 1M: +6.27%); VXX falling (1W: -1.63% | 1M: -18.76%) confirms fear easing but credit spread elevated (Level 0.7292 ABOVE TREND) — net mixed.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Credit stress showing strain: HYG (1W: -0.13% | 1M: +1.14%) CORRECTION and LQD (1W: -0.40% | 1M: +0.59%) CORRECTION with credit spread ABOVE TREND. Fear is moderating: VXX (1W: -1.63% | 1M: -18.76%) BELOW TREND; SPY/TLT flat with SPY in CORRECTION (1W: -1.34% | 1M: +1.90%) — trend exhaustion.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Neutral-to-easing financial conditions: Dollar weakness UUP proxy (Dollar Strength Level 27.8801 1W: -0.46% | 1M: -1.06%) BELOW TREND and TLT (1W: -0.50% | 1M: -1.02%) BELOW TREND suggest yields drifting but no clear risk rally.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Cyclicals leading: XLF (1W: +1.46% | 1M: +6.27%) ABOVE TREND, XLY (1W: +1.71% | 1M: +6.47%) ABOVE TREND and XLB (1W: +1.53% | 1M: +5.14%) ABOVE TREND. Tech lagging: XLK (1W: -4.26% | 1M: +0.40%) in CORRECTION — style: Value/Cyclicals showing relative strength.

5. US vs Global?  
US equities in short-term pullback: SPY (1W: -1.34% | 1M: +1.90%) CORRECTION; Emerging markets weak with EEM (1W: -3.99% | 1M: -2.52%) BELOW TREND and China FXI (1W: -3.18% | 1M: -4.60%) BELOW TREND, so US relatively resilient vs EM.

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Speculative demand moderating: IWM (1W: -2.12% | 1M: +7.15%) CORRECTION and ARKK (1W: -4.18% | 1M: +5.55%) CORRECTION show 1W weakness vs 1M gains; IBIT (1W: -5.26% | 1M: -4.55%) BELOW TREND signals crypto risk-off.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Precious metals strong: GLD (1W: +1.95% | 1M: +6.72%) ABOVE TREND and SLV (1W: +3.39% | 1M: +27.49%) ABOVE TREND; base metals showing fatigue with CPER (1W: -0.53% | 1M: +6.42%) in CORRECTION.

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy under pressure: XLE (1W: -5.06% | 1M: -2.93%) BELOW TREND and broad oil proxies USO (1W: -6.02% | 1M: -7.03%) BELOW TREND, BNO (1W: -4.92% | 1M: -7.38%) BELOW TREND; UNG (1W: -15.50% | 1M: -14.66%) BELOW TREND signals severe natural gas weakness.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
Confirmed: Financials and cyclicals have both timeframes positive (XLF ABOVE TREND). Divergence: SPY (1W: -1.34% | 1M: +1.90%) CORRECTION and XLK (1W: -4.26% | 1M: +0.40%) CORRECTION create a MINOR divergence pattern — watch for follow-through.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor cyclicals/value exposure (XLF (1W: +1.46% | 1M: +6.27%) ABOVE TREND, XLY (1W: +1.71% | 1M: +6.47%) ABOVE TREND) and monitor tech (XLK (1W: -4.26% | 1M: +0.40%) CORRECTION) for further weakness; reduce exposure to highly speculative ETFs showing below-trend behavior.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: Financials XLF (1W: +1.46% | 1M: +6.27%) ABOVE TREND and Discretionary XLY (1W: +1.71% | 1M: +6.47%) ABOVE TREND if breadth holds. BEARISH: Tech XLK (1W: -4.26% | 1M: +0.40%) CORRECTION and Energy XLE (1W: -5.06% | 1M: -2.93%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: Gold GLD (1W: +1.95% | 1M: +6.72%) ABOVE TREND and Silver SLV (1W: +3.39% | 1M: +27.49%) ABOVE TREND for safe-haven flows. BEARISH: Oil proxies USO (1W: -6.02% | 1M: -7.03%) BELOW TREND and Natural Gas UNG (1W: -15.50% | 1M: -14.66%) BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?  
VXX 20 (VXX (1W: -1.63% | 1M: -18.76%) BELOW TREND) as complacency threshold; credit spread ~0.73 (ABOVE TREND) for stress; XLK/XLF gap (XLK (1W: -4.26% | 1M: +0.40%) CORRECTION vs XLF (1W: +1.46% | 1M: +6.27%) ABOVE TREND) for tech-to-value rotation.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

Sector Rotation, not Risk-Off; Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive and VXX (1W: -1.63% | 1M: -18.76%) BELOW TREND shows fear easing while credit spread remains elevated. Cyclicals and Financials (XLF (1W: +1.46% | 1M: +6.27%) ABOVE TREND, XLY (1W: +1.71% | 1M: +6.47%) ABOVE TREND) are showing relative strength versus Tech (XLK (1W: -4.26% | 1M: +0.40%) CORRECTION). Key risk: tech/market 1W weakness vs 1M gains (CORRECTION pattern) — monitor for continuation or reversion.
